column2: [intro]
I am an artist with offbeat humor
My style is unique, it must be appreciated
I make people laugh with my songs
Through my words, I teach them lessons
What's your tone, my friend
In this life, what is your challenge?
Just a smile or a play on words
What's your tone, tell me, beautiful
In this world where everything is serious
I bring lightness, I am happy
My songs are like soap bubbles
They burst with laughter and make bodies move
What's your tone, my friend
In this life, what is your challenge?
Just a smile or a play on words
What's your tone, tell me, beautiful
[ solo ]
So everyone, turn up the volume
And together let's find our own tone
Let's dance, sing, laugh in unison
What's your tone, my song to you?
[outro]
